title: Reproducible targets Pipelines for Physiological Signal Analysis
text: Reusable targets pipeline factories Physio ecosystem. factory returns list targets, whole reproducible _targets.R standard analysis couple lines — incremental re-runs, dependency tracking, byte-level provenance free. box every factory runs bundled/synthetic demo data (ECG uses MIT-BIH 100 excerpt PhysioIO; EEG/EMG/EDA use seeded synthetic signal pp_simulate()). Point real data records= / source=.
code: # _targets.R library(targets) library(PhysioPipe)  list(   tar_ecg_hrv(),        # resting ECG -> R-peaks -> RR -> HRV (time + freq) + figure   tar_eeg_bandpower(),  # EEG -> band power per channel   tar_emg_features(),   # EMG -> linear envelope + spectral fatigue   tar_eda_scr()         # EDA -> tonic/phasic -> SCR features ) targets::tar_make()             # build (skips unchanged steps) targets::tar_visnetwork()       # view the DAG targets::tar_read(ecg_hrv)      # a result

title: Reproducible targets Pipelines for Physiological Signal Analysis
text: targets factory one binding. actual analysis logic exposed CLI writes language-neutral Parquet, step runs targets, Nextflow, plain shell — output readable Python/DuckDB. Verified equivalent: CLI, targets, Nextflow produce mean_hr = 72.03, sdnn = 1.389 bundled MIT-BIH 100 record; Parquet reads back Python R runtime.
code: # Layer 2 — orchestrator-agnostic CLI (writes Parquet) Rscript $(Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("cli/physio-ecg-hrv.R", package="PhysioPipe"))') \     --record data/100 --channel 1 --out results/100_hrv.parquet  # Layer 3b — Nextflow calls the same CLI (container-ready for HPC/cloud) nextflow run $(Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("nextflow/ecg_hrv.nf", package="PhysioPipe"))') \     --record data/100 --outdir results # Layer 3a — targets emits the same Parquet as a tracked target tar_read(ecg_parquet)   # "results/ecg_hrv.parquet"

title: ECG heart-rate-variability pipeline (target factory) — tar_ecg_hrv
text: Builds standard resting-ECG pipeline list targets: read -> lead -> R-peaks -> RR -> {HRV time, HRV freq} -> summary, plus RR-tachogram figure. one record fans via dynamic branching (one branch per record) adds combined cohort table.

title: ECG heart-rate-variability pipeline (target factory) — tar_ecg_hrv

title: ECG heart-rate-variability pipeline (target factory) — tar_ecg_hrv
text: name Target-name prefix (string; targets "<name>_pe" etc.). records NULL use bundled demo record (MIT-BIH 100 excerpt), character vector WFDB record bases (paths without extension). channel Lead index analyse (MIT-BIH 100: 1 = MLII, 2 = V5). detector ecgDetectRpeaks() method (e.g. "pan_tompkins", "hamilton").
